subtitle: A meal planner app that writes the grocery list from your dinners.
about: A small app inside a Pinto Notes note, with the week's dinners, who cooks, and a grocery list made from them by aisle, minus what's in the cupboard. Ask your AI to plan the week, or plan it and tick things off yourself.

ask.prompt: Set up the meal plan and groceries template in my Pinto Notes.

slides.label: Plan the week
slides.you: Plan this week's dinners. Oskar cooks Tuesday, Wednesday and Sunday, and we're out Saturday.
slides.ai: Planned all seven nights with what each dinner needs. The grocery list follows by aisle.
slides.alt: The week of 16 November: a dinner each night and who cooks, then 12 things left to buy

slides.label: Add to the list
slides.you: Add oat milk and coffee to this week's list.
slides.ai: Added 2 l of oat milk under Dairy and eggs, and coffee under Dry goods.
slides.alt: The grocery list by aisle, with Oat milk under Dairy and eggs and Coffee under Dry goods

slides.label: Use it yourself
slides.note: Or plan and tick it yourself.
slides.alt: The groceries by aisle, 9 of 21 bought, ticked things crossed out
